missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend zinc for hair loss without assessing diet, existing supplements, duration and possible medical causes.
safety_exclusions: Do not infer zinc deficiency from hair loss alone.
Do not recommend chronic high-dose zinc for cosmetic goals.
Do not overlook copper deficiency from excessive zinc.
professional_escalation_conditions: Sudden or patchy hair loss, scalp inflammation, systemic symptoms, pregnancy/postpartum, thyroid disease or suspected nutritional deficiency.
population_and_context: People concerned about hair loss; hair loss is multifactorial and does not by itself establish zinc deficiency.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. If deficiency is suspected, clinical assessment and appropriate testing should guide treatment.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Zinc fact sheet describes deficiency and toxicity; hair loss alone is nonspecific and does not establish a zinc indication. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
